title: Undercover
intro.text: Everyone gets the same task on their phone – except one player who's undercover. They have to blend in without getting caught. Find them!
intro.rules: More than half of you must vote for the same person. Catch the undercover player early for more points. If they survive 3 tasks, they win the round.
intro.physical: All tasks happen in real life – raise hands, show fingers, point at someone. Watch each other closely!
how.hands: Everyone will raise their hand – or not.
how.number: Everyone will show a number with their fingers.
how.point: Everyone will point at a person.
read.title: Read your task!
task.label: Your task
faker.title: You're undercover!
faker.text: You don't know the task. Act like you do – and don't get caught.
vote.title: Who's undercover?
vote.discuss: Discuss – then vote on your phone!
vote.change: You can change it while time is running.
result.noMajorityText: The undercover player stays hidden – next task.
result.wrongText: {name} was innocent. The real undercover player was {faker}!
scores.title: Scores
final.title: Final scores
faker.hands: On “NOW!”, everyone raises a hand – or doesn't. Glance at the others and decide fast.
faker.number: On “NOW!”, everyone shows a number with their fingers. Pick a number that fits in – nothing extreme.
faker.point: On “NOW!”, everyone points at a person. Point where others are pointing.
faker.vote: Vote for someone else – steer suspicion away from you!
rounds.label: Round {n} of {total}
